Nagar ki or kekaiy ka sainy bal barh raha hai. kekaiy ke sainik gupt rup se takshashila men ghus aae aur yuddh prarambh ho gaya. aur takshashila ke senapti kahan hai? khud senapti ko nahin pata vo kahan hai .ab takshashila ka kya hoga ....dekhie is bhag men.
Kekaiya's military force is moving towards Takshashila. Kekaiya's soldiers secretly entered Takshashila and the war started. And where is the Commander of Takshashila? The commander himself does not know where he is. Now what will happen to Takshashila...see in this part.
